name: Baked Salmon with Sweet Potato and Greens
ingredients: Salt, pepper, and lemon juice to taste
prep_steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss sweet potato cubes with half the olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread on a baking sheet.
Season salmon with garlic powder, salt, pepper, and lemon juice. Place on the same sheet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until salmon is cooked through and sweet potato is tender.
Toss greens with remaining olive oil and serve alongside.

name: Chicken and Quinoa Grain Bowl
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini dressing or lemon vinaigrette
prep_steps: Cook quinoa according to package directions and let cool slightly.
Season chicken with salt, pepper, and your favorite spices. Grill or pan-cook until done.
Roast vegetables at 425°F (220°C) for 15-20 minutes.
Assemble the bowl: quinoa on the bottom, then chicken, vegetables, avocado, and tomatoes.
Drizzle with dressing.

name: Red Lentil and Vegetable Soup
ingredients: Salt, pepper, and squeeze of lemon
prep_steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, and garlic in a tablespoon of olive oil until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add cumin and stir for 30 seconds.
Add lentils, tomatoes, and broth. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes until lentils are very soft.
Season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice. Blend partially if you prefer a creamier texture.

name: Tofu and Vegetable Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 block firm tofu, pressed and cubed
2 cups mixed stir-fry vegetables (broccoli, snap peas, carrots, bell pepper)
Cooked brown rice or noodles for serving
prep_steps: Press tofu for 15 minutes, then cut into cubes.
Heat sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Cook tofu until golden on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables with garlic and ginger for 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return tofu to the pan, add soy sauce, and toss to combine.
Serve over brown rice or noodles.

name: Turkey Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons soy sauce or coconut aminos
Toppings: shredded carrots, cucumber, green onion
prep_steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook ground turkey with onion and garlic, breaking it up as it cooks, about 6-8 minutes.
Add water chestnuts and soy sauce, stir to combine.
Spoon the mixture into lettuce cups.
Top with shredded carrots, cucumber, and green onion.

name: Mediterranean Plate
prep_steps: Arrange hummus in the center of a plate.
Surround with cherry tomatoes, cucumber, olives, and feta.
Garnish with fresh herbs.
Serve with pita or crackers on the side.

name: Sheet Pan Chicken with Roasted Vegetables
prep_steps: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss vegetables with half the olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Season chicken with paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Nestle among the vegetables.
Drizzle remaining olive oil over chicken.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) and vegetables are golden.
